parse.title: Falador Diary
parse.wikitext:
==Elite==
{| class="wikitable lighttable qc-active diary-table" style=width:750px; data-diary-name="Falador" data-diary-tier="Elite"
! style="width:50%;" | Task
! style="width:50%;" | Requirements
|-
|1. Craft 252 [[Air Rune]]s simultaneously from Essence without the use of [[Runic extract|Extracts]].
|
*{{SCP|Runecraft|88|link=y}}
*{{SCP|Runecraft|77|link=y}} with 2 [[Raiments of the Eye]] pieces
*{{SCP|Runecraft|66|link=y}} with 3 [[Raiments of the Eye]] pieces
*{{SCP|Runecraft|55|link=y}} with 4 [[Raiments of the Eye]] pieces
*28 [[Pure essence|pure]], [[Daeyalt essence|daeyalt]], or [[rune essence]] (less may suffice at higher [[Runecraft]] levels)
*Access to the [[Air Altar]] ([[air talisman]]/[[air tiara|tiara]], [[elemental talisman]]/[[Elemental tiara|tiara]], or the [[Abyss]])
|-
|2. Purchase a [[white 2h sword|White 2h Sword]] from [[Sir Vyvin]].
''Note: Selling this sword to him and then buying it back without having the proper rank does not count for this achievement.''
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[Wanted!]]
*1,920 [[coins]]
*Rank of [[White equipment#Knight rankings|White Knight Master]] (requires a [[Black Knight]] kill score of 1300 - this rank automatically starts at White Knight Novice, with a kill score of 100)
|-
|3. Find at least 3 [[magic roots]] at once when digging up your [[magic tree (Farming)|magic tree]] in [[Falador]].
''Note: You need to cut the tree down yourself.''
|
*{{SCP|Farming|91|link=yes}} and {{SCP|Woodcutting|75|link=yes}}
*[[Magic sapling]], [[spade]] and any [[axe]]
|-
|4. Perform a [[Cape of Accomplishment|skillcape]] or [[Quest point cape|quest cape]] emote at the top of [[White Knights' Castle|Falador Castle]].
|
*Completion of all [[quest]]s or [[Skill mastery|level 99]] in any skill
*Any [[Cape of Accomplishment]] (except for [[Cape of Accomplishment#Joke Skillcapes|joke skillcapes]] or the [[Max cape]])
|-
|5. Jump over the [[Strange floor (Taverley Dungeon)|strange floor]] in [[Taverley Dungeon|Taverley dungeon]].
''Note: Might take several tries. You must take no damage from the jump.''
|
*{{SCP|Agility|80|link=yes}}
|-
|6. Mix a [[Saradomin brew]] in [[Falador east bank]].
|
*{{SCP|Herblore|81|link=yes}}
*[[Toadflax potion (unf)]], [[crushed nest]]
|}

===Rewards===
*[[Falador shield 4]]:
**Can restore full [[prayer points]] twice a day
*[[Antique lamp (elite)|Antique lamp]] worth 50,000 experience in any skill of at least level 70
*The [[tree patch]] in [[Falador Park]] will never get [[Disease (Farming)|diseased]]
*Access to the larger [[Amethyst crystals|amethyst]] mine in the west of the [[Mining Guild]]
*Slightly increased chance of receiving higher level [[Pay-dirt#Cleaning|ores]] when cleaning [[pay-dirt]], by about 1% per ore{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1239199151243644928|date=15 March 2020|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/101939|archivedate=15 March 2020|quote=There's just one buff to pay-dirt, and it's for the elite diary only. This matches what the diary master says if asked.|name=Falador Diary reward tweet}}{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1536370067935358978|date=13 June 2022|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/109709|archivedate=9 July 2022|quote=The roll for each ore type is increased by about 1 percentage point.}}
